title: Sean McVay talks Puka Nacua's game status, Aaron Donald's return & more ahead of Week 2 vs. Giants
headline: Puka Nacua is questionable for Monday night with a new groin/hip soreness and did not practice, so his status is uncertain. Jordan Whittington is doubtful, and Aaron Donald is set to make his return.
summary: McVay opened with the final injury report. Puka Nacua was a DNP and is questionable with soreness (McVay said groin, and also referred to it as a hip), and whether he plays is still to be determined. McVay called it a separate issue from the earlier one, saying Nacua had a good practice but did not feel fully like himself or able to open up to full speed. Jordan Whittington is doubtful with a quad injury. Kamren Kinchens is out with a hamstring injury, Omar Speights is full, and Nathan Landman and a player McVay called Cam Kerr are limited. The other DNPs were rest days. McVay praised Aaron Donald, who is returning and expected to play, and said he has provided a spark. Miles (Garrett) is on IR after surgery, which makes Donald's return more important. McVay also praised the interior offensive line (Kevin Dotson, Steve Avila, Coleman Shelton) and the tackles, and said Wesley Bailey earned a roster spot with his preseason play. The opponent is the Giants, coached by John Harbaugh, on Monday Night Football.

injuries.detail: DNP with soreness (groin/hip), a separate issue from the earlier one. McVay is being cautious with him as a skill player, and his game status is to be determined.
Quad injury; McVay called him doubtful for the game.
Hamstring injury; DNP and out for the game.
Returning to the team and expected to play, with McVay saying he looks really good.

signals.claim: Nacua's availability for Monday night is undetermined, and he will not practice on the final practice day.
signals.note: The Rams' top receiver is a true game-time decision, so fantasy managers should have a backup plan.
signals.quote: whether or not he plays, um, you know, is to be determined.

signals.claim: Whittington is doubtful and unlikely to play Monday night.
signals.note: His absence thins the receiver depth, especially if Nacua is also out.
signals.quote: Jordan Whittington is doubtful for the game.

signals.claim: Donald will return and play in Monday night's game.
signals.note: His return strengthens the Rams' defensive front and is a boost to their defensive fantasy outlook.
signals.quote: If he said it, he's going.

signals.claim: Bailey earned a spot on the 53-man roster with his preseason play.
signals.note: He is a depth piece on the defensive line who could get some snaps, with Donald back and Miles on IR.

signals.claim: Miles (likely Garrett) is on IR after surgery that went well, and the team looks forward to his return.
signals.note: McVay said only 'Miles', so the identity is uncertain, and his absence matters for the defensive line.
signals.quote: Surgery went well like we talked about.

topics.detail: McVay praised guards Kevin Dotson and Steve Avila, along with center Coleman Shelton and tackles Alaric Jackson and Warren McClendon, saying the interior is key to the offense and provides physicality and pocket protection.
McVay is excited for the home opener in his 10th season and noted the Giants play a distinctive style under John Harbaugh, shown in their opener against the Cowboys.
